claim.summary: Linear error transfer: in the setting of lem:polynomial-numbering-transfer with 2 <= D <= ceil(N/2), K = 1 and any number of pigeons, for a set of polynomials of degree <= 1 with edge set S, a numbering has that lemma's property for {1} and S exactly when (i) no edge of S is in the hole of rank N-1, (ii) every edge of S in the hole of rank N-2 has its pigeon first, (iii) every edge of S in the hole of rank N-3 has its pigeon last; under such a numbering their common kernel in V_1 modulo C equals the common kernel modulo H plus C cap V_1.
